children: HSBC raised its year-end target for the S&P 500 index
to 8,100 from 7,650 on Tuesday, citing continued strength in corporate earnings.

"We see AI capex as a key catalyst, supporting semiconductors and broader AI-linked equities, alongside a resilient macro and consumer backdrop that underpins the rest of the index," the brokerage said in a note.
